description: The file defines the LocalizationController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Admin plugin. It manages the preparation of localization-related data (such as supported languages and date formats) for rendering in a view component, leveraging traits and base classes typical in an MVC framework.

classes.name: LocalizationController
classes.description: Controller handling localization configurations for the admin interface, extending AbstractVueController and leveraging localization services to prepare data for views.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares localization data (supported languages and date formats) and assigns it to a view component before rendering.
